notes.title: Update 10
notes.notes:
Alpha 10 Changelog
Added Audience to Events
Added Suspension Tuning and Tire Pressure
Changes to gameplay Difficulty
Added Starting Money $10,000 
Fixed Force Feedback Settings not saving
Increased Power Values for all cars
Events now give prize even if completed last place
Selling a car prompts a confirmation box
Fixed a Pink Car in garage
Revised Race Track for easier driving
Revised Dirt Roads for easier driving
Improved Map Visuals

notes.title: Update 9.4 has released! Force Feedback for some devices has been added
notes.notes:
Several things were improved due to player feedback
Added Experimental Force Feedback for Logitech Trusthmaster and some Fanatec Models
The jump in the race track is now easier to complete
Other players now have map icons to be easy to find
Cars have an angle readout to know how steep the hill you are climbing is
Added new challenging hill climb near spawn

notes.title: Alpha 2.1 Patch
notes.notes:
Alpha 2.1 Changelog
Added engine temperature simulation and engine damage (Repairs automatically by returning to garage)
Made changes in lighting engine to fix bugs
Fixed wrong payouts for all events
Fixed Pathfinder event no showing waypoints correctly
Added Map to default keybinds (M) or (Start) in controllers
Made changes to input for steering wheel compatibility
